definitions.en: A coordinate plane is a grid on which any point can be identified by an ordered pair of numbers or coordinates. The coordinate plane is represented by two perpendicular number lines: the horizontal x-axis and the vertical y-axis; also called the Cartesian plane or the Cartesian coordinate system.
definitions.es: Un plano de coordenadas es una cuadrícula en la que cada punto puede ser identificado por un par ordenado de números o coordenadas. El plano de coordenadas se representa por dos rectas graduadas y perpendiculares: el eje horizontal x y el eje vertical y; también llamado plano cartesiano o sistema cartesiano.

definitions.en: A ratio is a comparison of the quantity or measure of two different things. A ratio can be written as a fraction, with a colon, or with the word “to”. For example: ¾ is a ratio which shows how many yellow blocks there are to blue blocks, which can also be shown as 3:4 or 3 to 4.
